### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused fixes cover both reported failures with regression tests and no identified blocking issues. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes streamed tool-call handling in LLPhant’s OpenAI chat integration. **Changes:** - Accumulates argument fragments by tool-call index. - Executes collected calls on Gemini’s `stop` finish reason, while excluding truncated responses. - Adds regression tests for fragmented and index-free calls. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​Unit/​Chat/​OpenAIChatTest.php | Adds regression tests for both failures. | | tests/​Fixtures/​OpenAI/​gemini-openai-compat-parallel-tool-calls.sse | Provides a Gemini parallel-call stream fixture. | | src/​Chat/​OpenAIChat.php | Preserves argument fragments and handles compatible finish reasons. |
Review effort: Balanced
